title: Beta Lens: Operational Launch Orchestration & Feedback Closure for Lighthouse Pilots
creator: Asha Patel
description: Purpose: Coordinate a tightly orchestrated launch runway for the 'Beta Lens' lighthouse pilot group that ties release notes communication, cross-team playbooks, and a closed-loop feedback lifecycle. Scope: onboarding up to 12 lighthouse accounts into a staged beta (wave A/B), publish a single canonical release notes artifact, wire telemetry for activation and quality signals, and operationalize a 3-week feedback closure cadence. Out of scope: public GA rollout, pricing negotiations. Stakeholders: PM (Asha), Eng lead (Liam Chen), Design lead (Mariana Ruiz), Ops (Sofia Park), Sales AE lead (Ravi Mehta), Customer Success (Elena Novak). Deliverables: 1) Launch Runbook (on Confluence) with step-by-step tasks and rollback criteria; 2) Release Notes canonical doc and trimmed summary for external comms; 3) Feedback triage playbook and weekly cadence; 4) Dashboard with activation, error-rate, latency, and quality regressions; 5) Post-pilot learnings report with recommendations for GA. Communication cadence: daily syncs during ramp (first 72 hours after each wave), twice-weekly stakeholder check-ins, and a final lessons-learned review. Primary channels: #pilot-beta Slack channel, weekly GTM review doc, and customer-facing release notes in Drive. This ticket centralizes coordination and assigns owners for release notes signoff, signal instrumentation, and customer outreach templates.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical release_notes document published and approved by PM, Eng, and Legal
Each lighthouse account has a personalized onboarding checklist completed and signed off by Customer Success
Telemetry: activation, first-successful-call, median latency, and error-rate metrics visible in dashboard with alerts configured
Feedback triage flow established and staffed (owners assigned for bugs, quality regressions, and feature asks)
Rollback and mitigation plan documented and rehearsed with Eng and Ops
success_metrics: Activation rate (first successful API call) >= 85% within 48 hours of onboarding
Mean latency across pilot <= target SLO (250ms tail) for 95th percentile
Critical production defects <= 1 per 1000 calls during pilot
Customer feedback closure: 90% of categorized issues have an owner and next-step within 5 business days
Qualitative NPS-like ask: average satisfaction >= 8/10 in pilot close survey
